categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution, and cosmetics. Its pharmaceutical manufacturing focuses on traditional Chinese medicine products such as Pien Tze Huang and other related medicines. The cosmetics segment includes skincare and personal care products under brands like Pien Tze Huang and Queen. Pharmaceutical distribution involves marketing and sales of pharmaceutical products through various channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages traditional Chinese medicine formulation techniques protected as national secrets, with production methods recognized as intangible cultural heritage. It integrates modern scientific research methods including pharmacology, clinical studies, and molecular mechanism research to innovate and validate traditional medicines. The company also employs advanced manufacturing processes and maintains multiple national-level technology platforms, including enterprise technology centers and research laboratories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, pharmacies, healthcare institutions, and end consumers both domestically and internationally. The company serves markets in China extensively, with growing presence in Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, and other overseas regions. It targets consumers seeking traditional Chinese medicine, health supplements, and cosmetics, as well as institutional clients in medical and health sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant market penetration in regions such as Fujian, Guangdong, Beijing, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Chongqing, Hubei, Hunan, Henan, and Yunnan. It also has overseas operations and sales in Hong Kong, Indonesia, Thailand, and Macau. The company’s subsidiaries and joint ventures extend its geographic footprint across multiple provinces and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical and cosmetics supply chains. It manufactures finished pharmaceutical products and cosmetics, distributes these products through its own and partner retail channels, and engages in direct sales to consumers and institutions. It also manages upstream activities such as raw material sourcing and cultivation of medicinal herbs to ensure supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening traditional Chinese medicine innovation through secondary development of core products, new drug development pipelines including chemical and herbal medicines, and expanding clinical research. The company invests heavily in R&D platforms, collaborates with academic and research institutions, and focuses on digital transformation and AI-driven data analytics. It also emphasizes sustainable development through quality medicinal herb cultivation and ecological protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of pharmaceuticals, health supplements, and cosmetics. The company sells via multiple channels including direct retail, wholesale distribution, online platforms, and institutional sales. It also earns income from investments, licensing, and government subsidies related to research and development activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the traditional Chinese medicine industry, recognized as a national-level high-tech enterprise and a top brand with strong cultural heritage. It competes with other established pharmaceutical and cosmetics companies in China, maintaining a strong market position through brand reputation, product quality, and innovation. Its inclusion in major stock indices reflects its industry prominence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported total revenues of approximately RMB 10.79 billion in 2024, representing a 7.25% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 2.98 billion, growing 6.42% from the prior year. Total assets reached RMB 17.54 billion with shareholders’ equity of RMB 14.27 billion, indicating steady growth and solid financial health. The company maintains a strong cash flow position and continues to invest in expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique heritage and proprietary traditional Chinese medicine formulations, protected by national secrets and recognized as intangible cultural heritage. It combines traditional efficacy with modern scientific validation and innovation, offering clinically proven products with multi-functional benefits. Its strong brand equity, extensive distribution network, and commitment to quality and sustainability differentiate it in the competitive pharmaceutical and cosmetics markets.
